title: Victor Cannon Leadership Podcast™
author: Jerome Hopkins, CHA | Victor Cannon Leadership
description: Build Leaders. Strengthen Teams. Deliver Results. Join Jerome Hopkins, CHA, Founder and CEO of Victor Cannon Leadership, for practical conversations that help leaders think with greater clarity, lead with greater intention, execute with greater discipline, and deliver stronger results. Drawing on 30 years of leadership experience, Jerome explores communication, team development, culture, customer experience, and leadership under pressure. New episodes every Monday. Explore our resources at VictorCannon.com.
